blocks.text: BOSTON — Jalen Johnson had 24 points, Nickeil Alexander-Walker scored Atlanta’s final four points as part of a 20-point night and the Hawks beat the Boston Celtics 87-86 on Friday in the final NBA Cup group-stage game for both teams. The Celtics and Hawks finished 3-1 in Cup play, with Atlanta winning the group thanks to taking the head-to-head matchup against Boston. The Hawks have won five straight. Alexander-Walker finished off a drive with 54.3 seconds left to break a tie, then sealed it with two free throws that made it a four-point game with 2.6 seconds remaining. READ: NBA Cup: […]...
